reviews.title: Preserve authored gradient and bitmap alpha in animated masks
reviews.summary: Cached authored gradients and decoded PNG sources share the dynamic alpha path, including mixed/nested transforms, animated sources and Restart. Geometry defaults remain unchanged. Text/video, fully scripted mask-of-mask graphs and cache/error edge behavior remain bounded.

entries.note: Authored/dynamic gradient, PNG and mixed animated sources preserve cached alpha. Text/video and fully scripted masked-source graphs remain unsupported; filter-only cache downgrade remains limited.
